title: Bill of Sale
summary: Record the sale of a car, boat, equipment or other personal property, with price, condition and title promises.

title: Equipment Rental Agreement
summary: Rent out equipment, gear or tools with a deposit, condition checks and responsibility for damage.

title: Event and Venue Booking Agreement
summary: Book a venue or event space with dates, fees, deposits, cancellation and house rules.

title: General Release of Claims
summary: One party gives up claims against another, usually in exchange for a payment.

title: Loan Agreement
summary: A fuller loan contract than a note: purpose, disbursement, repayment, promises, default, and optional collateral.

title: Payment Plan Agreement
summary: Let a customer or debtor pay an existing balance over time, with a schedule and what happens if a payment is missed.

title: Photo, Video and Likeness Release
summary: Permission to photograph or record someone and use their image, voice and name.

title: Promissory Note (Unsecured)
summary: A borrower's written promise to repay a loan, with interest, payments, late fees and default terms.

title: Change Order
summary: Document a change to the scope, price or schedule of an existing contract.

title: Consulting Agreement
summary: Engage a consultant or advisor on an hourly, project or monthly-retainer basis.

title: Employment Offer Letter
summary: A clear at-will job offer covering role, pay, start date, benefits and conditions.

title: Independent Contractor Agreement
summary: Hire a freelancer or independent contractor for defined services, with payment, IP and confidentiality terms.

title: Multi-Member LLC Operating Agreement
summary: A plain-English operating agreement for an LLC with two to four members: ownership, votes, money, exits.

title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
summary: Two parties share confidential information with each other and both agree to protect it.

title: Mutual Release of Claims
summary: Two parties settle a dispute or end a relationship by releasing each other from claims.

title: One-Way Non-Disclosure Agreement
summary: One party shares confidential information and the other agrees to protect it.

title: Quote and Proposal Acceptance
summary: Turn a quote or proposal into a binding order with a deposit and basic terms.

title: Referral Agreement
summary: Pay a referral or finder's fee to someone who introduces new customers.

title: Sales Commission Agreement
summary: Set out how and when a salesperson or sales representative earns commissions.

title: Services Agreement with Statement of Work
summary: A master services agreement with general terms, plus a first statement of work for the specific project.

title: Simple General Partnership Agreement
summary: Two partners set out contributions, profit split, decisions and what happens if one leaves.

title: Single-Member LLC Operating Agreement
summary: A simple operating agreement for an LLC with one owner, supporting liability protection and succession.

title: Amendment to Real Estate Purchase Contract
summary: Change the price, closing date, repairs or other terms of a signed purchase contract.

title: Assignment of Real Estate Purchase Contract
summary: Transfer a buyer's rights under a purchase contract to a new buyer for an assignment fee, with the disclosures many states now require.

title: Bird Dog (Lead Referral) Agreement
summary: Pay a 'bird dog' a fee for finding off-market property leads, while limiting their role to providing information.

title: Earnest Money Receipt
summary: Acknowledge receipt of an earnest money deposit and state how it will be held and released.

title: Lead-Based Paint Disclosure (Sale or Lease)
summary: The federally required lead-based paint disclosure for selling or renting housing built before 1978, using the exact federal warning statements.

title: Property Management Agreement
summary: Hire a manager to lease, collect rent and maintain rental property, with fees, spending limits and trust-account rules.

title: Real Estate Letter of Intent (Non-Binding)
summary: Outline the key deal terms for a property before negotiating a full purchase contract. Mostly non-binding.

title: Residential Lease Agreement
summary: A plain-English lease for a house, apartment or unit: rent, deposit, maintenance, entry, pets and ending the lease.

title: Residential Purchase Agreement
summary: A plain-English contract to buy and sell a home, with financing, inspection, title and closing terms, plus hooks for state addenda.

title: Room Rental and Co-Living Agreement with House Rules
summary: Rent a private room in a shared home, with shared-space rules, utilities, chores, guests and move-out terms.

title: Termination of Purchase Contract and Release of Earnest Money
summary: End a purchase contract by agreement and tell the escrow holder how to release the earnest money.

title: Contract for Deed (Installment Land Contract)
summary: Seller keeps title while the buyer pays the price in installments, then delivers the deed at payoff. Includes strong state-specific protections.

title: Novation Agreement
summary: Replace one party to a contract with a new party, with the other party's consent, releasing the departing party.

title: Promissory Note Secured by Real Estate
summary: The buyer's note for a seller-financed sale, secured by a separately recorded mortgage or deed of trust.

title: Real Estate Joint Venture Agreement
summary: A capital partner and an operating partner team up on one property: who funds, who works, how profits are split, and how it ends.

title: Residential Lease with Option to Purchase
summary: A residential lease paired with a separate, paid option giving the tenant the right (not the obligation) to buy at a set price.

title: Seller Acknowledgments and Disclosures (Creative Finance)
summary: Seller confirms, item by item, that they understand the deal, the equity involved, the risks, and that they were advised to get independent counsel.

title: Seller Financing Addendum
summary: Add owner financing terms to a purchase contract: down payment, rate, amortization, balloon, security, insurance and compliance.

title: Subject-To Existing Financing Addendum
summary: An original addendum for buying a property subject to the seller's existing mortgage, with separately initialed acknowledgments by buyer and seller.

title: Wraparound Financing Addendum (AITD)
summary: Seller finances the sale with a new note that 'wraps' the seller's existing mortgage, which the seller keeps paying from the buyer's payments.

title: Artist Management Agreement
summary: Appoint a personal manager, with commission, what income is excluded, term, post-term (sunset) commissions and limits on authority.

title: Band Partnership Agreement
summary: Two to four band members agree on the band name, money, decisions, songwriting, gear and what happens when someone leaves.

title: Beat Purchase Receipt and License Summary
summary: A short signed receipt for a beat purchase that records what was bought, the license type and its main limits.

title: Featured Artist Agreement
summary: A guest artist records a verse or feature on another artist's song, for a fee, credit, optional points and an agreed writer share.

title: Master Use License (Sound Recording)
summary: License a specific sound recording (master) for use in film, TV, ads, games or online video.

title: Music Collaboration Agreement
summary: Two artists or producers making a joint project agree on ownership of songs and masters, costs, decisions, income and credit.

title: Producer Agreement: Exclusive Beat License
summary: An artist gets exclusive rights to use a beat, with no caps. The producer stops licensing it, and may keep ownership, take points and receive a SoundExchange share.

title: Producer Agreement: Non-Exclusive Beat Lease
summary: License a beat non-exclusively for one song, with stream, sales and video caps. The producer keeps ownership and can lease the beat to others.

title: Producer Agreement: Work for Hire and Buyout
summary: An artist or label commissions a production and owns the resulting beat and master outright, with a fee, optional points and agreed writer credit.

title: Publishing Administration or Co-Publishing Agreement
summary: A simple deal where a publisher registers and collects for a songwriter's songs for a fee (admin), or also takes a share of ownership (co-pub).

title: Remix Agreement
summary: Commission a remix of a track, with stems delivery, fee or royalty, credit, ownership of the remix master and approval.

title: Sample Clearance License
summary: License the use of a portion of an existing recording or song (a sample or interpolation) in a new track.

title: Session Musician and Vocalist Release
summary: Pay a session player or background vocalist a flat fee and get the rights to their recorded performance.

title: Song Split Sheet
summary: Record who wrote a song and each writer's ownership share, PRO, IPI number and publisher, ideally on the day it is written.

title: Synchronization License (Composition)
summary: License a song's composition (music and lyrics) for use in timed relation with video: film, TV, ads, games or online video.

title: Joint Venture Agreement
summary: Two parties team up on a specific project, sharing contributions, control and profits without merging their businesses.

title: Profit Share Agreement
summary: Give someone a share of a business's or project's net profits without giving them ownership.
